testCase.name: XML Layout Inflation
testCase.description: Runtime inflation error due to unknown attribute

error.message: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView

expectedFix.explanation: Remove invalid attribute or use android:textStyle="bold"

agent_response.error: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView
agent_response.rootCause: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView in app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml line 12 due to invalid or unsupported attribute android:textFontWeight
fixGuidelines: 1. Examine the XML file at app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml and check for any attributes that might be causing issues, such as unsupported attributes like android:textFontWeight.
2. Ensure all required attributes are present in the layout elements. For example, if a TextView is being used without necessary attributes like width or height.
3. Consider removing or replacing invalid attributes to see if the error persists.
